Illinois Valley Wheelm'n Tuesday Evening Ride

Dunlap, IL · Road

No-drop

Illinois Valley Wheelm'n Tuesday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Dunlap, IL. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Dunlap Grade School. About 20–30 miles, about 17 mph average, regroups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Illinois Valley Wheelm'n Tuesday Evening Ride group ride

The Peoria area club's Tuesday night road ride, just north of Peoria in Dunlap. Mileage is 20 to 30 as daylight allows. The group averages about 17 mph and regroups so nobody is left behind. Start time shifts to 5:30 pm in the shoulder months.
